label: The Santa Method (Adversarial Maker ≠ Checker)
description: A dual-agent convergence loop where a generator subagent (Fire Gate) creates the initial artifact, and an independent adversarial reviewer subagent (Crown Gate) ruthlessly audits against taste and canon until strict consensus is reached.
convergence_rule: Output is only delivered to the user or committed to git when both agents agree and all 4 audit dimensions (Attestation, Contradiction, Taste, Safety) pass with 0 blocking issues.
failure_modes: Infinite critique loops without progress (mitigated by max 3 iterations before human escalation)
Checker leniency (mitigated by strict rubrics in TASTE.md and CANON_LOCKED.md)
code_example:
1. Dispatch Fire Gate Generator -> Draft.
2. Dispatch Crown Gate Reviewer -> Critique & Score.
3. If Score < 90, Generator refines addressing exact feedback.
4. If Score >= 90, emit SIP Attestation and merge.

label: The Dreaming Reflection Engine
description: Scheduled sleep-time background agent (Letta pattern) that scans delta modifications in the vault, formulates higher-order epistemic questions, retrieves cited evidence, and generates verified reflection nodes.
convergence_rule: Candidate insights must cite existing notes with exact path and anchor, pass privacy redaction, and survive contradiction checks before writing to patterns/YYYY-Www.md.
failure_modes: Hallucinated relationships across unlinked notes (mitigated by mandatory citation verification)
Privacy leakage of local_core into public summaries (mitigated by PrivacyGuardian regex filter)
code_example:
1. Delta scan at 04:00 daily.
2. Pose 3-5 salient questions about recent decisions and patterns.
3. Retrieve notes by Relevance x Recency x Importance.
4. Synthesize Lens framed insights with SIP attestation.
5. Log reflection delta to calibrate next week's generator.

label: Single Dev Server (SDS) Transient Compute
description: Policy and supervisor tool ensuring local dev servers are treated as ephemeral compute with idle TTL, keeping memory free and directing persistent reviews to Vercel previews.
convergence_rule: Dev servers automatically terminate after 30 minutes of idle inactivity. Port allocations are strictly managed without collisions.
failure_modes: Orphaned background node processes consuming RAM (mitigated by sds doctor and process tree reaping)

label: Cross-Model Verification Shootout
description: Maker and Checker must run on different model architectures/providers to eliminate shared blindspots (e.g., Kilo free-tier generates, Codex GPT-5.6 Sol or Claude Opus audits).
convergence_rule: High-impact changes must be attested by a secondary model from a distinct lab/family.
failure_modes: Single-model blindspot reinforcement (eliminated by architecture diversity)

label: Hierarchical Queen-Conductor-Worker Swarm
description: Decouples meta-strategic planning from task decomposition and task execution. The Queen manages the global objective, Conductor orchestrates worktrees, and Workers execute bounded tasks in parallel isolated branches.
maker_role: Worker Agent (Execution / Code Generation / File Edits)
convergence_rule: All subagent worktrees pass unit tests (npm test), static linting (npm run lint), and git diff verification before conductor executes merge into primary integration branch.
failure_modes_mitigated: Context drift in long execution loops
Conflicting parallel file writes across worktrees
Premature goal termination before complete verification

cross_repo_applications.context: Visual task tree execution and worker telemetry.

label: Dynamic Semantic Dispatch & Model Routing
description: Routes agent tasks dynamically based on cognitive load and cost tier: fast lightweight models for mechanical lookups and scans (Shift/Flow gates); high-reasoning frontier models for architecture, judgment, and adversarial reviews (Crown/Unity gates).
convergence_rule: Routing heuristic: Single-file edits and AST lookups (<2k tokens) route to Free Tier / Haiku; multi-file refactors and architectural reviews route to Frontier Tier (Opus / GPT-5.6 Sol) with automatic fallback to secondary provider if error rate > 0%.
failure_modes_mitigated: Overspending on trivial text formatting tasks
Under-reasoning on complex architectural decisions
Single-provider outage vulnerabilities

cross_repo_applications.context: Default free auto-router mapped to frontier escalation.
Universal provider capability matrix and fallback routes.

label: Evaluator-Optimizer & Self-Refining Teleprompters
description: Iterative feedback loop where an Optimizer agent generates candidate prompts or code, an Evaluator agent scores against a suite of assertion tests, and teleprompter algorithms compile few-shot examples into optimized execution weights.
convergence_rule: Iteration stops when test suite assertion pass rate >= 95.0% across 50 holdout validation prompts, or when performance score delta across 3 consecutive iterations is < 0.01.
failure_modes_mitigated: Superficial prompt tuning without ground-truth metrics
Regression errors in multi-turn tool calling
Model drift across provider updates

cross_repo_applications.context: Automated evaluation and ranking of system prompts.

label: Blackboard Architecture & Shared Observable Workspace
description: A centralized, observable state repository where autonomous specialist agents read shared problem states, post intermediate discoveries, and react to changes asynchronously without tight peer-to-peer coupling.
convergence_rule: Arbiter verifies: 1) Zero unresolved merge conflicts, 2) All required field schemas validated via Zod, 3) 100% test pass rate, and 4) State SHA-256 checksum matches integration target.
failure_modes_mitigated: N-squared communication explosion in large swarms
State desynchronization across parallel subagents
Lost intermediate discoveries during agent restarts

cross_repo_applications.context: Visual blackboard surface for human and agent interaction.
Persistent markdown blackboard for daily knowledge logs.

label: Map-Reduce Parallel Swarm Scanner
description: Fan-out of dozens of lightweight scout agents to inspect distinct files, repositories, or API endpoints in parallel (Map), followed by a synthesis agent that aggregates, deduplicates, and condenses findings into a single coherent dossier (Reduce).
convergence_rule: 100% of mapped repository paths return valid JSON AST receipts, and reducer verifies zero duplicate node IDs before compiling master estate index.
failure_modes_mitigated: Sequential bottleneck in multi-repo scanning
Context window overflow from massive code dumps
Incomplete estate discovery

cross_repo_applications.context: Estate indexing script scanning 221 repositories in parallel.

label: Multi-Agent Adversarial Debate & Red-Teaming
description: Two or more frontier models debate an architectural, security, or strategic proposition from opposing stances (Thesis vs Antithesis), moderated by an impartial Judge model that extracts synthesized truth (Synthesis).
convergence_rule: Judge model extracts non-contradicted propositions with >= 90/100 rubric score, generates reconciled AST diff, and verifies 0 logical contradictions against CANON_LOCKED.md.
failure_modes_mitigated: Model confirmation bias and sycophancy
Overlooking subtle security vulnerabilities
Premature consensus on suboptimal architectures

cross_repo_applications.context: Thesis debate protocol for strategic investments and architecture.

label: Queue-Backed Durable Agent Worker Swarm
description: A distributed job queue (BullMQ/Redis or SQLite durable queue) decouples user request dispatch from execution. Workers pull tasks from priority queues with token rate-limit sharding, exponential backoff with jitter, and dead-letter queues for failed trajectories.
convergence_rule: Task payload produces verifiable git commit or signed artifact hash, updates job state to completed with zero unhandled exceptions, and cleans up temporary worktree.
failure_modes_mitigated: Provider 429 rate limit cascades
Process crash losing in-memory agent state
Uncontrolled memory spikes from simultaneous unthrottled spawns

cross_repo_applications.context: Coordinates multi-agent task queue and state handoffs.
Visualizes job status, worker slots, and throughput telemetry.

label: KV-Cache Prefix Alignment & Context Compaction
description: Maximizes provider prompt caching (Anthropic 90% discount, Gemini context caching) by structuring agent prompts with an immutable static prefix (System contract, tools schema, core lore) followed by dynamic turn deltas, reducing inference latency by 80% and token cost by 75%.
convergence_rule: Prompt prefix hash remains identical across >= 90% of swarm turns, achieving verifiable cache hit rate >= 80% on supported model endpoints.
failure_modes_mitigated: Compounding API billing from repeated full-history reinjection
Context processing latency spikes in multi-turn loops
Context truncation shedding critical rules

cross_repo_applications.context: Static prefix contract enforced across all harness adapters.
Prompt templates compiled with deterministic static-header blocks.

label: Hierarchical Graph Partitioning & 2-Hop Neighborhoods
description: When the knowledge graph scales past thousands of entities, agents do not ingest the whole tree. The graph is sharded into domain clusters, and agents query only the 2-hop radius around target concepts via topological traversal or semantic vector filtering.
convergence_rule: Extracted subgraph context fits within <= 8,000 tokens while capturing 100% of direct prerequisite and unlock edges for target problem.
failure_modes_mitigated: Context window exhaustion from loading whole-estate schemas
Irrelevant distractors degrading agent reasoning accuracy
Client-side bundle bloat on the web visualizer

cross_repo_applications.context: Dynamic domain loader sharding data files.

label: Agent Sandbox Isolation & Blast Radius Containment
description: Executes untrusted code, web scraping, and third-party dependencies inside isolated lightweight containers or WASM sandboxes with restricted network access, virtualized filesystems, and strict Phone Link / root directory search bans.
convergence_rule: Execution finishes within resource limits (CPU, memory, timeout), produces signed outputs in scratch directory, and leaves host filesystem completely unaltered.
failure_modes_mitigated: Accidental deletion or corruption of host files
Malicious code execution from third-party repositories
Phone Link recursive sync triggering infinite mobile file downloads

cross_repo_applications.context: Enforces execution safety gates and mutation permissions.
